title.zh: ZachXBT: Stolen Funds from the $6.3B Binance Exploit and $388M Bitget Exploit Co
title.en: ZachXBT: Stolen Funds from the $6.3B Binance Exploit and $388M Bitget Exploit Co

current_state.zh: ZachXBT reported that stolen funds from the $6.3B Binance exploit and the $388M Bitget exploit were bridged through THORChain and commingled at the same address, indicating a single North Korea-linked actor also tied to the Phemex hack.
